startup_object_boundary: The two selections observe only active-frame dimensions. A separately audited startup/dependency boundary must exclude hidden data loads, other populated frames and stored participant objects. No whole-session absence is certified by these payloads and no additional inspection is authorized.
budget_semantics: Unadopted design ceilings, not measured Stata performance. One monotonic native clock origin precedes first owned process launch. Admission requires strictly less than the relevant deadline. The second dispatch must precede t=80 and have at least its nominal 10 seconds before t=90. All initialization, commands, control and cleanup share the same envelope. A nominal tool timeout is not independent containment.
literal_selections:
* Verify a newly owned session; do not clear unexpected data.
display "WP06_EMPTY_BEGIN"
display "N=" c(N) " K=" c(k)
if (c(N) != 0 | c(k) != 0) {
    error 459
}
display "STATA=" c(stata_version)
display "FLAVOR=" c(flavor)
display "BUILD=" c(born_date)
display "MAXVAR=" c(maxvar)
* Confirm that the same owned session remains empty.
display "WP06_EMPTY_END"
display "N=" c(N) " K=" c(k)
if (c(N) != 0 | c(k) != 0) {
    error 459
}
transport_contract: Future execution must use an explicitly bound isolated Stata-MCP selection interface, not shell Stata, a batch do-file, direct PyStata substitution or the shared default session. Admission must reject before dispatch if multi_session_enabled is false or the exact bound session manager is unavailable; it must never enter the current single-session direct-execution branch. This document supplies neither endpoint nor executable launcher. Existing exposed schemas do not provide a worker-epoch, no-replacement or independent-control capability.
wrapper_allowance: Only after separate source-bound review: the exact initialized engine, dependency/startup behavior, first-call seed prefix, MCP named-log wrapper and isolated infrastructure metadata. No arbitrary extra selection, data viewer, graph export, help execution or file runner. Current temporary/shared paths are not approved output destinations.
